diffs.diff: acceleration (mg, +/-400 g range, 12-bit digit): datasheet reading gives 195 per count, the part's model has 0.049, 0.049, 0.049
diffs.evidence: H3LIS331DL datasheet (DocID023111) Table 3 Mechanical characteristics, So Sensitivity: 'FS bit set to 00, 12-bit representation: 49; FS bit set to 01: 98; FS bit set to 11: 195 mg/digit'. The model's driver and sim use the default +/-100 g range (CTRL_REG4 = 0x80, FS = 00) and report g, so 49 mg/digit = 0.049 g per 12-bit count is correct. The second reading's 195 is the +/-400 g (FS = 11) sensitivity in mg; the driver also maps 400 g to 195 mg/digit. Different range and units, same datasheet table.

diffs.diff: chip ID register 0xf: part 50, datasheet reading 51
diffs.evidence: Datasheet section 7.1 WHO_AM_I (0Fh), Table 16: bits '0 0 1 1 0 0 1 0'; 'This register contains the device identifier that for the H3LIS331DL is set to 32h.' Register map: 'WHO_AM_I r 0F 000 1111 00110010'. 0x32 = 50, as in the model. The reader also confirmed 51 was a transcription error.
